$comment: Structural WFR v1-v4 contract generated from tt_telemetry::wfr_receipt::WfrReceipt. Structure alone does not prove signature integrity, issuer identity, math replay, provider usage, or invoice reconciliation.
description: A signed workflow-run receipt as deserialized from the cloud `VerifyReceiptResponse` JSON shape. Money fields are integer micro-USD (`i64`) — they are the canonical-payload inputs directly (no float canonicalization). The `verifying_key_hex` + `signature_hex` make the receipt offline-verifiable with no key lookup (mirrors `VcrReceipt` / `L2Receipt`). The convenience `*_usd` fields are NOT part of the signature.

baseline_micros.description: Baseline cost (without TokenTrimmer) in micro-USD — field 6.

baseline_usd.description: Convenience: baseline_micros / 1_000_000. NOT part of the signature.

canonical_version.description: Canonical schema version (`v1`/`v2` legacy or `v3`/`v4` request-delta).

cost_micros.description: Actual run cost in micro-USD — canonical-payload field 5.

cost_usd.description: Convenience: cost_micros / 1_000_000. NOT part of the signature.

org_id.description: Org that owns the run — canonical-payload field 2.

quality_verdict.description: The flow-level quality-gate verdict a v2/v4 receipt was minted with (`equivalent` / `degraded` / `inconclusive`), or `None` for a v1/v3 (not-sampled) receipt. Part of the v2/v4 canonical payload's trailing field.

request_delta_eligible_requests.description: Non-truncated requests in the signed run cohort (v3/v4 only).

request_delta_formula_version.description: Exact formula identifier signed by v3/v4.

request_delta_measured_requests.description: Strictly measured requests in that cohort (v3/v4 only).

run_id.description: The workflow run ID (also the receipt primary key).

saved_micros.description: Positive-only request delta in micro-USD. For v3/v4 it must equal `max(signed_request_delta_micros, 0)`.

saved_usd.description: Convenience: saved_micros / 1_000_000. NOT part of the signature.

signed_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp the receipt was first minted (frozen by DB).

signed_request_delta_micros.description: Signed v3/v4 request delta. A regression remains negative.

signed_request_delta_usd.description: Convenience signed request delta in USD. NOT part of the signature.

status.description: Nonempty terminal status at seal time — canonical-payload field 8.

verifying_key_hex.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte Ed25519 verifying (public) key. Embedded so verification needs no external key lookup.

workflow_id.description: Workflow the run belongs to — canonical-payload field 3.

title: TokenTrimmer workflow-run receipt
